description: Source of the std-backlog labels. Sync (scripts/sync.mjs --apply) creates or fixes them in target repos with the same name, color, and description. Labels not listed here (GitHub default labels, etc.) are not deleted. This file is not copied to target repos (see data in templates/index.json).

labels.name: priority/P0
labels.description: Top priority: urgent, security, or a requirement the user marked urgent

labels.name: priority/P1
labels.description: High: a prerequisite for other work, or cleanup of existing duplication

labels.name: priority/P3
labels.description: Normal: shared code that will be needed soon

labels.name: type/feature
labels.description: New feature or new managed target

labels.name: origin/added
labels.description: Requirement added by the user during work

labels.name: needs-user
labels.description: Includes a step the user must do

labels.name: epic
labels.description: Per-area parent issue: groups work issues as sub-issues (std-backlog section 6)
